detail.longDescription:
Lily (Xiaozhi) is a smart AI Agent assistant designed for Android and Wear OS, helping you learn, explore knowledge, and enjoy fun quiz games anytime, anywhere – right from your wrist.

With multiple assistant profiles, Xiaozhi adapts to different learning styles and goals, making education and entertainment simple, fast, and engaging.

⚙️ MANY INTEGRATED TOOLS:
- Lunar calendar (Perpetual calendar)
- Calculator: basic, scientific, programming
- Unit converter
- Date calculator
- Loan calculator
- Heart rate monitor
- BMI calculator
- File sharing
- Speed ​​meter
- Flashlight management
- Compass, spirit level
- Metal detector
...

🎮 MULTI GAMES:
- Xiangqi Game
- Chess
- Go
- Checkers
- Othello
- Caro Chess
- Jumping Chess
- Carrying Chess

🌍 MULTI-LANGUAGE LEARNING
Practice conversations in multiple languages
Learn vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation
Suitable for beginners and advanced learners

📚 MULTI-SUBJECT KNOWLEDGE
Math, Literature, English, Physics, Chemistry, History, Geography
Science, technology, and general knowledge
Clear and easy-to-understand explanations

🎮 FUN & INTELLIGENT QUIZ GAMES
Play popular quiz shows with AI:
Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
Road to Mount Olympia
Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader
Progressive difficulty with diverse questions

⌚ OPTIMIZED FOR WEAR OS
Clean and simple interface for smart watches
Fast access and instant responses
Perfect for quick learning and short breaks

🤖 PERSONALIZED AI ASSISTANT
Multiple assistant personalities (teacher, friendly helper, study partner)
Tailored to your learning needs and interests
Always ready to assist you

✨ Lily (Xiaozhi) is more than an AI assistant — it’s your personal learning and entertainment companion on Wear OS.

📍DISCLAIMER
· Heart Rate Monitor & BMI should not be used as a medical device in the diagnosis of heart diseases.
· Heart Rate Monitor not intended for a medical emergency. Consult your primary care physician if you need any help.
· In some devices, Heart Rate Monitor may make the LED flash very hot.
